about:
Precision Steel, operating as Precision Steel Construction, is a locally owned and operated steel erection contractor headquartered in Fargo, North Dakota. The company serves the tri-state region of Minnesota, North Dakota, and South Dakota from its Minnesota base. No founding year or founders are disclosed in public materials.

The firm specializes in structural steel erection, steel decking installation, and construction welding. Its erection scope covers hoisting, layout, placement, connecting, welding, burning, guying, bracing, bolting, plumbing, and rigging of structural steel, steel joists, bridge girders, and metal buildings. Decking services include floor deck installation from manufacturer drawings with a focus on rapid, safe fastening. Welding is performed on-site using advanced techniques, though specific equipment is not listed. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Precision Steel works primarily with general contractors and builders on commercial, institutional, and government projects. Past project types include government buildings, strip malls and retail centers, service stations, churches, and schools across the tri-state area.

The company emphasizes quality and safety compliance on every job, and aims to complete erection and decking quickly so follow-on trades can proceed without delay. It positions itself as a reliable partner for builders needing experienced crews for structural steel and decking packages.
